meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

copy.tagline: 输入基因名,几秒拿到数据库注释与序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做生物信息研究,经常需要快速查询基因或序列数据
copy.tagline_en: Query gene and sequence databases in seconds
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do bioinformatics research and need fast database lookups.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过命令行或 Python 调用 gget,从 20 多个生物数据库快速取数:基因信息、序列比对、蛋白质结构、表达数据等,命令行默认输出 JSON,Python 返回表格。
howto.when: 当用户提出生物信息学快速查询需求时触发,例如查基因信息、做 BLAST/BLAT 序列比对、获取 AlphaFold 蛋白质结构等。

say.note: 会运行 gget search 并返回基因列表。

say.text: 用 BLAST 比对这段蛋白序列
say.note: 将运行 gget blast,默认最多返回 50 条结果。

say.text: 下载 PDB 结构 7S7U 并保存
say.note: 运行 gget pdb 并保存到文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call gget via CLI or Python to quickly fetch data from 20+ bioinformatics databases: gene info, sequence alignment, protein structures, expression data, etc. CLI outputs JSON by default; Python returns DataFrames.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for quick bioinformatics lookups, e.g., gene information, BLAST/BLAT sequence alignment, or AlphaFold protein structures.

say_en.text: Search for GABA-related genes in humans.
say_en.note: Runs gget search and returns a gene list.
Runs gget blast, up to 50 hits by default.

say_en.text: Download PDB structure 7S7U and save it.
say_en.note: Runs gget pdb and saves to file.
